content.rendered:
Ready for K’ Play Days

Join us for one or both days to learn about school readiness, connect with other Kinder families and spend time with some of our amazing teaching team!
The fun will happen on the Archer Glen Playground on July 17th and August 14th from 6:30 – 7:30 pm
Open to all incoming Archer Glen kindergarten students and their families. Free learning activity, crafts, and refreshments provided.
